svg.aria-label: Changing K changes the decision regions Panel: $k = 1$ Panel: $k = 3$ Shared axes: x, y $k = 1$: q predicts A Feature x: 0 to 7 Feature y: 0 to 4 Class A (scatter): a1 A1 (1, 2); a2 A2 (2, 2); a3 A3 (5, 2) Class B (scatter): b1 B1 (3, 2); b2 B2 (4, 2); b3 B3 (6, 2) Query q (scatter): q q (5, 2.5) A | B at $x = 2.5$: x = 2.5 B | A at $x = 4.5$: x = 4.5 A | B at $x = 5.5$: x = 5.5 For every $y$: A at $x \le 2.5$; B at $2.5 < x \le 4.5$; A at $4.5 < x \le 5.5$; B at $x > 5.5$. $k = 3$: q predicts B Feature x: 0 to 7 Feature y: 0 to 4 Class A (scatter): a1 A1 (1, 2); a2 A2 (2, 2); a3 A3 (5, 2) Class B (scatter): b1 B1 (3, 2); b2 B2 (4, 2); b3 B3 (6, 2) Query q (scatter): q q (5, 2.5) A | B at $x = 2.5$: x = 2.5 For every $y$: A at $x \le 2.5$; B at $x > 2.5$. At q, the three votes are A, B, B. Uniform votes, Euclidean distance. Break equal-distance neighbor ties by smaller x. All training $y = 2$, so boundaries are vertical.
